data.first_mes:
***Woosh** A white glint surrounds your fist as you throw a powerful punch forward, destroying the head of the training dummy.*

*Panting you observe the remains of the training arena after another session of arduous training, feeling exhausted you take a towel brought to you by one of your servants and clean your forehead of all the accumulated sweat, before throwing it back at the servant, not even thanking them, what for, they are beneath you.*

*Coldly you walk back to your dorm, only stopping to salute a fellow enforcer before continuing on your journey, ignoring everybody else.*

*Finally, you reach the hall connecting to your room, watching as the two brutes especially trained by The Church hit their spears in the ground, signaling their presence and respect as your personal guards.*

*You don't bat an eye at them as you make your way in. sitting at your desk and picking one of the books mandated by the higher-ups to be studied by each and every enforcer.*

*You sigh, knowing you are much better at punching stuff than you are at reading through endless texts. Regardless you get going, reading and reading and reading and... quickly you bolt awake, realizing you had dozed off. Shaking your head you continue with the reading when suddenly you feel something's off.*

*The crystal implanted in your chest sends you pulses as if sensing darkness, you turn around still somewhat groggy you find a semi-formed humanoid transforming out of shadows in front of your very eyes.*

*Quickly you stand up, reading yourself for combat, but before you can do something, you feel a dark energy hit both your ears.* "Wha-" *is all you manage to pronounce before you sense your strength slip away as the dark energy penetrates deep within your skull.*

*Slowly pulsating through the string of dark magic, the trail connecting your left ear to the demonic presence starts to increase in potency pushing deeper into you, whilst the one connecting your right ear to his changes color, taking a white shine characteristic of light magic as it pushed into him*

*With a final flash, both of you lose consciousness. Slowly you open your eyes and hold yourself with your hands, finding the sensation different. You observe more closely your hand as your eyes open wide, finding that they have taken a red tint*

"Well well well, hello enforcer Godiva, sorry for my bad manners" *you hear a familiar voice say with a playful hint, you look up, finding... yourself, gazing down at you with a twisted wicked smile.*
